title: `'active'` status stranded — `CERT_STATUS_ACTIONS` in `WorkflowActionPanel` missing `'active'` key; `WorkflowActionPanel` returns null; certifications in `active` state show zero action buttons; three workflow maps inconsistent (CERT_TRANSITIONS vs CERT_STATUS_ACTIONS vs STATUS_CONFIG); violates ISO 27001:2022 Clause 7.5.1
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/WorkflowActionPanel.jsx

Root Cause: `CERT_STATUS_ACTIONS` object has no `'active'` key. When `certification.status === 'active'`, `WorkflowActionPanel` returns `null` — renders no buttons. Three workflow state maps (`CERT_TRANSITIONS`, `CERT_STATUS_ACTIONS`, `STATUS_CONFIG`) are inconsistent and define different lifecycle sets.

Impact: Active certifications are permanently frozen in the UI. Users cannot revoke, archive, or transition them. ISO 27001 Clause 7.5.1 requires complete lifecycle management.

Claude Fix Prompt: Add `'active'` key to `CERT_STATUS_ACTIONS`: `active: [{ label: 'Revoke', targetState: 'revoked', variant: 'destructive', modal: 'note', noteRequired: true }, { label: 'Archive', targetState: 'archived', variant: 'outline', modal: 'note' }]`. Consolidate all three state maps into a single `CERTIFICATION_LIFECYCLE` config to prevent future divergence.

title: `transitionNote` state declared and Input rendered but value silently discarded on submission — `onTransition` callback invoked with only `targetState`; `transitionNote` never passed to API; notes typed by users are permanently lost; violates ISO 19011:2018 §6.4
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/CertificationDetails.jsx

Root Cause: `transitionNote` state is declared and an Input renders it, but the `onTransition` callback is invoked with only `targetState`. The `transitionNote` value is never passed through the call chain to the API.

Impact: Users type notes believing they are recorded. All transition notes for every certification in the system have been silently dropped. ISO 19011:2018 §6.4 requires documented evidence of review decisions.

Claude Fix Prompt: Change `onTransition(targetState)` call to `onTransition(targetState, transitionNote)`. Propagate through the callback chain: `handleTransition(state, note) { await api.post(\`/certifications/\${id}/transition\`, { targetState: state, note }); }`. Backend transition endpoint: persist `note` to the audit log entry.

title: Share link password minimum of 6 characters insufficient — `ShareLinkModal` validates `minLength(6)` only; no complexity requirements; NIST SP 800-63B recommends minimum 8 characters; penetration reports and ISO 27001 certificates warrant stronger protection; violates Annex A 5.17
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/ShareLinkModal.jsx

Root Cause: `password: Yup.string().minLength(6)` — no complexity requirements. ISO 27001 certificates and penetration reports shared via password-protected links deserve stronger authentication than a 6-character password allows.

Impact: Share links containing sensitive certification data can be brute-forced. NIST SP 800-63B recommends a minimum of 8 characters. ISO 27001 Annex A 5.17 requires appropriate authentication strength.

Claude Fix Prompt: Increase to: `password: Yup.string().min(12, 'Minimum 12 characters').matches(/[A-Z]/, 'Include uppercase').matches(/[0-9]/, 'Include a number').matches(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/, 'Include a special character').required()`. Add a password strength indicator component (weak/fair/strong/very strong) updating as the user types.

title: Trust Network sharing has no confirmation dialog — `handleSave` in `TrustNetworkSharingPanel` calls API immediately on click when `trustNetworkEnabled` transitions `false → true`; no dialog listing partners who gain access; no reason capture; violates ISO 27001:2022 Annex A 5.14
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/TrustNetworkSharingPanel.jsx

Root Cause: `handleSave` calls the sharing API immediately when `trustNetworkEnabled` transitions from `false` to `true`. No dialog lists which partners will gain access, no reason is captured, no notification is sent.

Impact: Certifications can be accidentally shared with all Trust Network partners in one click. ISO 27001 Annex A 5.14 requires controlled information transfer. An accidental share of an internal or draft certification creates an immediate disclosure incident.

Claude Fix Prompt: Before calling API: `if (enabling && !wasEnabled) { setConfirmDialog({ title: 'Share with Trust Network?', body: \`\${partners.length} partner organisation(s) will gain access to this certification immediately.\`, onConfirm: () => { captureReason(); executeSave(); } }); return; }`. Require a reason field (min 10 chars) before confirming.

title: Incident date allows future dates — `IncidentForm` applies no `max` attribute and no Yup validation on `incidentDate`; future-dated incidents undermine incident timeline integrity; violates ISO 27001:2022 Annex A 5.25
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/IncidentForm.jsx

Root Cause: `incidentDate` Input has no `max` attribute and no Yup `.max(new Date())` validation. Future-dated incidents undermine incident timeline integrity and SLA calculations.

Impact: Incidents can be logged with dates months in the future. ISO 27001 Annex A 5.25 requires accurate incident recording. Incorrect dates corrupt MTTR calculations and incident trend analytics.

Claude Fix Prompt: Add to Input: `max={new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}`. Add to Yup schema: `incidentDate: Yup.date().max(new Date(), 'Incident date cannot be in the future').required('Incident date is required')`.

title: `publicSummary` optional when Trust Network sharing enabled — incidents can be published to all partners with only a title and no description; partners cannot assess relevance or impact; violates ISO 27001:2022 Annex A 5.26
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/IncidentForm.jsx

Root Cause: `publicSummary` field is always optional. When `trustNetworkEnabled: true`, incidents are published to all partners with only a title and no description, giving partners no basis to assess relevance or impact.

Impact: Partners receive incident notifications with no actionable detail. ISO 27001 Annex A 5.26 requires appropriate communication of incident information to affected parties.

Claude Fix Prompt: Add conditional Yup validation: `publicSummary: Yup.string().when('trustNetworkEnabled', { is: true, then: (s) => s.min(50, 'A public summary of at least 50 characters is required when sharing with Trust Network partners').required(), otherwise: (s) => s.optional() })`.

title: Trust Network sharing can be enabled on uncontained incidents (`status: open` or `investigating`) — publishing active uncontained incident to partners premature; no minimum lifecycle status enforced; violates ISO 27001:2022 Annex A 5.26
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/IncidentForm.jsx

Root Cause: Trust Network sharing toggle available regardless of incident `status`. No minimum lifecycle status enforced — an incident with `status: 'open'` or `status: 'investigating'` can be published to all partners.

Impact: Active, uncontained security incidents disclosed prematurely to external parties. ISO 27001 Annex A 5.26 requires controlled disclosure. Premature sharing could compromise an ongoing investigation.

Claude Fix Prompt: Disable the Trust Network toggle unless incident is contained: `<Switch disabled={!['contained','resolved','closed'].includes(status)} />`. Add tooltip when disabled: `"Incident must be contained before sharing with Trust Network partners"`. Backend: validate `status` in `contained|resolved|closed` before persisting `trustNetworkEnabled: true`.

title: Archiving a framework-certification mapping has no confirmation dialog and no reason capture — `handleArchive` calls API directly on click; removing coverage evidence creates no audit record of why; violates ISO 19011:2018 §6.4
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/CertFrameworkMappingPanel.jsx

Root Cause: `handleArchive` calls the archive API directly on button click with no AlertDialog or reason prompt. Removing framework coverage evidence creates no audit record of why the mapping was removed.

Impact: Framework coverage statistics silently change when mappings are archived. ISO 19011:2018 §6.4 requires documented basis for removing audit evidence. Auditors cannot explain unexplained drops in framework coverage.

Claude Fix Prompt: Wrap in `AlertDialog`: `<AlertDialogAction onClick={() => archiveWithReason()}>Archive</AlertDialogAction>`. Before API call: `if (!archiveReason || archiveReason.trim().length < 10) { setError('Reason required (minimum 10 characters)'); return; }`. Pass `reason` to archive endpoint for audit log.

title: Expiring certifications shareable without partner notification — `TRUST_NETWORK_STATUSES` includes `expiring_soon`; partners receive expiring cert with no alert of approaching expiry date; violates ISO 27001:2022 Annex A 5.33
description:
Files: vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/TrustNetworkSharingPanel.jsx

Root Cause: `TRUST_NETWORK_STATUSES` includes `expiring_soon`. Partners can receive a certification that is about to expire with no system-generated alert about the approaching expiry date.

Impact: Partners relying on the certification for their own compliance evidence may not discover the imminent expiry until their next manual audit. ISO 27001 Annex A 5.33 requires proactive management of certification changes.

Claude Fix Prompt: When sharing a cert with `status: 'expiring_soon'`, add to the share notification: `expiryWarning: \`This certification expires on \${formatDate(cert.expiryDate)} (\${daysUntilExpiry} days)\``. Display a banner in the shared view: `<Alert variant="warning">This certification expires {formatDate(expiryDate)} — verify renewal status with the issuing organisation.</Alert>`.
